semiconductor_relevance: High — Toward Technologies specializes in high-precision signal control and switching solutions that are critical for semiconductor testing and automated test equipment.
summary: Toward Technologies, Inc. provides high-precision signal control and switching solutions tailored for semiconductor testing and automated test equipment. With over 35 years of experience, their product offerings include reed relays, solid-state relays, and RF MEMS switches, enabling customers to address complex signal switching challenges.
